classification: Product notice lifecycle defect exposed by the D22 read-only Source pointer diagnosis
cause: Capture correctly announces a no-workspace read failure before selection, but its notice has no typed resolution condition. NoticeHost keeps the bottom overlay mounted after the organization resolver reports a selected workspace, so the stale notice can intercept otherwise enabled controls.
sibling_census: The same stale Capture notice was documented as covering Settings Reset and Vault controls; those acceptance runners manually dismissed the exact alert after organization setup. Other database failures have different remedies and must remain visible.
repair: The shared Notice type carries a typed active-organization resolution condition. The database refusal producer marks only no-workspace notices. NoticeHost retires matching notices when the organization changes and rechecks on notice arrival for late refusals; unrelated errors are untouched.
verification: Red guard confirmed by root. Guarded focused green run notice-resolution-green-001 passed 24 tests across the new notice guards and sibling database refusal suite. Typecheck, independent source review and native read-only retest remain pending.
d22_boundary: The original Source Save click remains ambiguous. The private one-attempt checkpoint is unchanged; this repair neither dispatches Save nor authorizes retry.
